bio: Chef Jens Madsen serves up his extraordinary concept of Culinary Nomadism, in which local ingredients meet global influences, at the equally special – and architecturally impressive – BMW Welt. For a year at a time, the spotlight is shone on a specific region of the world, its culinary traditions and techniques, spices etc. Each season brings with it change and progression – like a cloud moving through the sky. Inspired by his own trip to Africa, the chef takes you on a voyage of discovery of the flavours of East and South Africa. Top-quality produce goes into a tasting menu made up of eight elaborate courses promising a unique and immersive experience. In addition to wine, there are truly fantastic alcohol-free pairings.
